shots.visual: A crystal glass shatters on the floor, red wine splashing everywhere like blood.

lines.speaker: zhao_tianhao
lines.text: 陳峰！你這勞改犯，竟敢動我趙家的人！

shots.visual: Sitting on the floor, face swollen, pointing at the protagonist with a vengeful look.

lines.speaker: zhao_meiling
lines.text: 哥！殺了他！他讓我當眾丟盡了臉！

shots.visual: Standing calmly with hands behind back, looking down at the antagonist with icy indifference.

lines.speaker: chen_feng
lines.text: 五年前你欠我的，今天只是收個利息。

shots.visual: Laughing maniacally, face contorted with arrogance.

lines.speaker: zhao_tianhao
lines.text: 利息？在江城，我趙天豪就是天！

shots.visual: He snaps his fingers, and several bodyguards move forward.

lines.speaker: zhao_tianhao
lines.text: 我要你跪著走出這道門！

shots.visual: A woman in a sharp suit walks in, holding a high-tech tablet, her presence commanding attention.

lines.speaker: lin_su
lines.text: 恐怕要跪下的人，是你。

shots.visual: Looking at the newcomer with confusion and hidden lust.

lines.speaker: zhao_tianhao
lines.text: 妳是哪來的賤貨？敢管我的閒事？

shots.visual: Adjusting her glasses, looking cold and professional.

lines.speaker: lin_su
lines.text: 我是陳先生的私人秘書。現在，請看大螢幕。

shots.visual: The huge TV screen in the living room suddenly turns on, showing stock market charts.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: 趙氏集團股價瞬間斷崖式下跌。

shots.visual: Staring at the screen, his face turning pale and sweat appearing on his forehead.

lines.speaker: zhao_tianhao
lines.text: 不可能……這可是十個億的資金盤！

shots.visual: Swiping the tablet, her fingers moving rapidly.

lines.speaker: lin_su
lines.text: 三分鐘前，趙氏地產的資金鏈已斷裂。

shots.visual: A subtle, cold smile on her lips.

lines.speaker: lin_su
lines.text: 兩分鐘前，您的三家子公司已被強制收購。

shots.visual: His phone rings incessantly, he answers it with a trembling hand.

lines.speaker: zhao_tianhao
lines.text: 餵？什麼？銀行要收回所有貸款？！

shots.visual: Clinging to her brother's leg, terrified by the sudden change in atmosphere.

lines.speaker: zhao_meiling
lines.text: 哥，到底發生什麼事了？你快說話呀！

shots.visual: Screaming into the phone, veins popping on his neck.

lines.speaker: zhao_tianhao
lines.text: 到底是誰在背後搞鬼！給我查！

shots.visual: Slowly taking a seat on the expensive sofa, crossing his legs.

lines.speaker: chen_feng
lines.text: 趙天豪，被自己引以為傲的金錢拋棄，感覺如何？

shots.visual: Pointing at the protagonist, his hand shaking uncontrollably.

lines.speaker: zhao_tianhao
lines.text: 是你？不……你一個窮囚犯哪來這麼多錢！

shots.visual: She hands a document to the antagonist with a mocking expression.

lines.speaker: lin_su
lines.text: 這是收購協議，請簽字吧，趙總。

shots.visual: Reading the document, his eyes widening in shock.

lines.speaker: zhao_tianhao
lines.text: 收購方……鐵血金控？那是全球前十的財團！

shots.visual: He stumbles back, bumping into a vase which crashes to the floor.

lines.speaker: zhao_tianhao
lines.text: 難道……難道陳峰跟鐵血金控有關係？

shots.visual: His eyes are cold as ice, reflecting the antagonist's fear.

lines.speaker: chen_feng
lines.text: 你還不配知道我的真實身份。

shots.visual: He suddenly turns to his bodyguards, desperate and crazed.

lines.speaker: zhao_tianhao
lines.text: 給我上！弄死他！只要他死了，合約就作廢！

shots.visual: She steps in front of the protagonist, several top-tier bodyguards appearing from the shadows behind her.

lines.speaker: lin_su
lines.text: 誰敢動陳先生一下，我就讓誰全家消失。

shots.visual: The antagonist's bodyguards look at each other, intimidated by the sheer aura of the professionals.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: 趙家的打手們被嚇得連連後退。

shots.visual: Covering her mouth, her world collapsing as she realizes the man she mocked is a giant.

lines.speaker: zhao_meiling
lines.text: 不……這不可能，他只是個臭要飯的……

shots.visual: Standing up, walking towards the antagonist with predatory slowness.

lines.speaker: chen_feng
lines.text: 趙天豪，你還有最後一張牌嗎？

shots.visual: Backing away until he hits the wall, his arrogance replaced by pure terror.

lines.speaker: zhao_tianhao
lines.text: 你……你別過來！我還有黑道的人脈！

shots.visual: Whispering in the antagonist's ear, cold and sharp.

lines.speaker: chen_feng
lines.text: 黑道？在監獄裡，他們都叫我——死神。

shots.visual: His legs give out, and he collapses to his knees.

lines.speaker: zhao_tianhao
lines.text: 陳……陳少，饒了我，我把財產都還給你！

shots.visual: Throwing a fountain pen onto the floor in front of him.

lines.speaker: chen_feng
lines.text: 簽字。然後，滾出這棟別墅。

shots.visual: Signing the document with a shaking hand, despair written on his face.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: 曾經不可一世的梟雄，此刻卑微如狗。

shots.visual: Looking at the final page of the document, he sees the authorized signature.

lines.speaker: zhao_tianhao
lines.text: 這簽名……「鐵血金控董事長，陳峰」？！

shots.visual: Dropping the pen, eyes bloodshot, realizing the full scale of the disaster.

lines.speaker: zhao_tianhao
lines.text: 原來……你才是幕後的大老闆！

shots.visual: Walking towards the exit without looking back, his figure tall and imposing.

lines.speaker: chen_feng
lines.text: 明天，我會親自去收購你的命。

shots.visual: He stares at the protagonist's back, then suddenly picks up a hidden phone, his eyes filled with murderous intent.

lines.speaker: zhao_tianhao
lines.text: 喂？龍哥……我要買一個人的命！今晚就動手！
